newsitem.title: USA: McDonnell Douglas gets UK helicopter orders.
newsitem.headline: McDonnell Douglas gets UK helicopter orders.

text.p: McDonnell Douglas Corp in a statement released at the Farnborough, England air show, said Police Aviation Services ordered 10 McDonnell Douglas twin-turbine MD Explorer helicopters.
It said the transaction is the largest in Europe for the eight-passenger MD Explorer, which began operating in the United States and other countries in late 1994.
United Kingdom-based Police Aviation Services provides air support to police agencies and aero-medical services.
Three MD Explorers will be delivered in 1997 with the first in June. Three more will be delivered in 1998 and the remainder in the years following.
The first aircraft will go into service with the Wilshire Constabulary Air Service Unit west of London.
